reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: After freezing the exact pair, reopened EER Article 16.9, the generic exchange-first schedule and Appendix IV. Independently added the credits and verified the approved exchange conditions. Revisited the official catalogue descriptions and prerequisites for methods, operations, data and the thesis skills course and the current workbook evidence for the affected UCR selections. Compared the results with the frozen record, including the restricted choices and optional research. This was a same-AI pass.
findings: The English-taught International Business BSc uses the regular route without Emerging Markets. Each of the first two years is 60 EC with eight 6.5 EC courses and two 4 EC skills trainings. Year 2 includes compulsory Quantitative Methods III and one choice from the approved skills list. The published regular-route Year 3 template totals 60 EC: 26 EC exchange, 13 EC chosen within one major, 6.5 EC from the specified elective lists, two 2 EC professional development units, 2.5 EC thesis skills and 8 EC individual thesis. The 2026–27 EER publishes both generic and named major outlines. The general pathway retains the restricted slots. Named exceptions in Accounting and Entrepreneurship have separate rules, and Accounting variant 2 has an internal wording discrepancy between article and table which is outside the selected generic template. Emerging Markets has distinct years 2 and 3, including a 19.5 EC internship and 10.5 EC thesis.

The first-year study phases place Quantitative Methods I before II and both before the case-based Quantitative Methods III. The Management Game follows foundational business courses. Managerial Finance and Accounting builds on first-year Finance and Accounting; Marketing Management and Management of Organisations build on the first-year management course. The generic first exchange option uses Semester 5 and Global Citizenship Skills, then the two major courses, restricted elective, thesis skills, Leadership Skills and individual thesis in Semester 6. The approved partner exchange requires 53.5 EC of Year 1 to apply and 60 EC before departure. At least 19.5 EC of exchange courses must be field-related. Article 12.1 confirms that the thesis is an individual academic paper. The published generic outline avoids the variant-specific restrictions.

The generic Year 3 template keeps the major choice within the regular route. Its 26 EC exchange and 8 EC individual thesis are separate from the restricted 19.5 EC of major and elective courses. The remaining 6.5 EC are the two professional skills components and thesis preparation.

Both 24-course UCR plans pass. Consumer Product Design contributes a concrete prototype and production-scaling sequence. Business & Economy in the Age of AI applies technology to firms and economic change, while the database course teaches technical data skills. These do not replace specialist operations or management information systems. Statistical inference and regression justify the Quantitative Methods III alignment. The emerging economies option materially changes the discipline mix and retains concrete international business content.
